sections.content: A BVN slip (Bank Verification Number slip) is the official physical or digital verification document that displays your unique 11-digit biometric identifier alongside your personal details, registered photograph, enrolment branch, and date of birth in the Nigerian banking ecosystem. Whether you are unblocking a restricted bank account, completing high-tier KYC verification, applying for an international travel visa, or onboarding with a new employer, possessing an authentic, clean copy of your BVN slip is a mandatory requirement.

Many bank customers mistakenly believe that knowing their 11-digit number is enough. However, financial institutions, embassies, and regulatory compliance teams require a visual document—the official BVN slip—to verify that your biometric records and facial capture match your submitted identity papers. Fortunately, you no longer have to spend hours in crowded commercial bank branches to get a reprint. Using the automated identity gateway of Ufriends IT (Print BVN Slip Online), you can verify, query, and print your official BVN slip in under 60 seconds directly from your smartphone or computer.

sections.content: BVN Slip Check Online: How to Verify Your 11 Digits
Before you can print or download your slip, you must confirm your 11-digit BVN. If you have forgotten the digits, you can perform a quick online or USSD check using approved national channels:

items: USSD Quick Retrieval (*565*0#): The central clearing house NIBSS publishes the universal code *565*0#. Dial this code from the mobile phone number originally linked to your BVN. A statutory fee of ₦20 is deducted from your airtime balance, and your 11-digit number displays on your screen.

Mobile Banking App Profile: Log into your official mobile banking app (GTBank, Access, Zenith, UBA, etc.). Under 'Settings' or 'My Profile', your linked BVN is typically displayed (either partially masked or full).

Online Verification via Ufriends IT: If you already know your number, you can query your full demographic slip directly on the Ufriends BVN Portal to inspect your registered name, phone, date of birth, and biometric photo.

sections.content: What a Valid BVN Slip PDF Contains (Key Security Features)
When downloading a BVN slip PDF sample or inspecting a newly generated printout, look for these essential security features to confirm its validity for official compliance:

items: Biometric Passport Photograph: A clear digital rendering of the original facial capture taken during your bank enrolment.
Cryptographic Verification QR Code: A scannable 2D barcode that encodes your verified identity token, readable by bank and immigration scanners.
Enrolment Branch Metadata: The specific bank name and physical branch location where your biometric profile was created.
Demographic Alignment: Complete spelling of First Name, Middle Name, and Surname matching your official National Identity Number (NIN).
Date of Birth & Phone Record: Formatted in standard DD-MMM-YYYY notation to prevent ambiguous date interpretations.

sections.content: How to Retrieve Your BVN If You Lost Your SIM Card
The USSD check (*565*0#) strictly requires the phone line linked to the BVN. If your SIM card was stolen, damaged, or lost, follow these steps:

items: Retrieve the Same SIM (Recommended): Visit your network provider (MTN, Airtel, Glo, or 9mobile) with your NIN slip and do a SIM replacement (SIM swap). Once the line is restored, dial *565*0# to view your BVN.
Check Previous Bank Statements: Many Nigerian banks print your BVN on physical paper account statements or in the header of electronic PDF statements sent to your email.
Visit Your Enrolling Bank: If you cannot recover the line, visit any branch of the bank where you registered. Present a valid ID and request a customer profile printout.
Update Linked Phone Number: If you need to permanently change the telephone line attached to your BVN, read our detailed BVN phone number change guide.

sections.content: Common Mistakes When Printing or Checking BVN Slips

items: Posting BVN on Social Media: Never post your 11-digit number or slip on Facebook, Twitter/X, or WhatsApp to ask for help. Fraudsters monitor these channels for identity theft.

Tampering with Downloaded PDFs: Never use image editing software to modify the name or date of birth on a BVN slip. Altered slips will fail instant cryptographic scanner checks at banks and embassies.
Ignoring Name Discrepancies: If the name on your BVN slip does not match your NIN, banks will freeze your account. Use our NIN and BVN mismatch resolution guide to harmonize records.
What is the official code to check BVN? Dial *565*0# from your registered phone number. A ₦20 operator fee applies.

Does the BVN slip contain my passport picture? Yes. Full Details BVN slips include the biometric passport photograph captured during bank enrolment.

What should I do if my BVN details are incorrect? If your name, DOB, or phone is wrong, submit an online request on the BVN Modification Portal.
